name: Containment Array
displayText: The first enemy Unit deployed each turn enters Exhausted.

notes: This rewrites the arrival itself, so the Unit is never Ready even for an instant — nothing can respond in between, and a Unit with Rush still cannot attack because it is Exhausted rather than Newly Deployed.
A Token an opponent creates counts as a Unit they deployed.
One arrival per turn, counted across the whole table: at three or four seats the first enemy deployment of the turn spends it.
